snippet.title: Merkava Full Gameplay
snippet.description:
Full Gameplay of Merkava, a Shmup video game with some ARPG mechanics.

Save the world from Dinah's threat by defeating angels, demons, beasts, and aliens.

You can get Merkava on Itch.io.
